description: This file defines the ZendeskHelpProcessor class, which handles interactions with Zendesk help center APIs, including constructing search and redirect URLs, and sending HTTP queries.

classes.name: ZendeskHelpProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing help requests via Zendesk API, including generating URLs and executing queries.

methods.name: getHelpConfigService
methods.description: Retrieves the HelpConfigService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP client instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for the help center from configuration.

methods.name: getSearchUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for searching articles with a specific label.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Gets the redirect URL for a given label based on search results.

methods.name: sendQuery
methods.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to the specified URL with proper headers and returns the response or null on failure.

methods.name: getDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Provides the default redirect URL for the help center.
